record.title: Observe exact acquired key parsing in a fresh disposable guest
record.intent: Establish a specimen-derived identity and key baseline before ordinary guest installation.
requirements: Commit and push admitted tasking before execution. Preserved files and isolated disposable guest only; no physical contact.

Preserve unchanged APK/native pins and exact acquired Key.data. Bind the fixture to sealed cached DNA and file-key evidence; match the key record identity to acquired identity evidence without publishing private values.
Use the established stock ART component and an explicitly fresh modeled private store. Do not claim current specimen option state or physical FRAM durability.

Observe original License initialization, exact key output and trailing-padding behavior, cached derived keys, key file preservation, private-record effects and the complete option catalog. No installer invocation or token production in this baseline.
Stop on unexpected hardware dependency, journal loss, guest instability, altered policy or mismatched pins. Retain any failed run; do not silently repair its outcome.
Independently verify raw journals and artifacts, hash and seal evidence, record limitations, commit and push the conclusion.
acceptance: A bounded baseline establishes actual stock parsing or records the first reproducible unsatisfied dependency.
